notes.title: 1.1.2 Patch notes out now !
notes.content:
1.1.2 Patch notes are now available ! 

This update includes bug fixes for levels 1 - 2 - 3 part 1 and 3 part 2.

1.1.2 Patch Notes :
Fixed  the not-responding game controller 
Fixed the not-working save game 
Fixed the intro cinematic not running 
Fixed the game crash at the church 
Fixed the not running level 3 
Fixed the floating guns 
Fixed all HUD visible in cinematic  
Improved character behaviors 
Improved the loading screen 
Improved the blocking volume 
Added the transition cinematic into the level 2 
Changed "Esc" key for "options"  

We keep working on the game for the additional content scheduled.
All players can expect future free updates !

Content of future updates soon :
Level 4 release
Level 5 release
Releases of levels 6 - 7 part 1 and 7 part 2

Thanks for your support and patience

The Lomay team

notes.title: 1.1.1 Patch Notes out now !
notes.content:
Dahalo’s first patch notes are now available ! 
These updates include bug fixes for levels 1 - 2 - 3 part 1 and 3 part 2. 

1.1.1 Patch Notes : 

Fixed the camera that stuns and wanders too much 
Fixed the difficulty of the so-called non-playable game
Updated gameplay 
Improved character behaviors 
Improved AI enemies 
Improved blocks and colliders 
Improved graphic quality 
Overall improvement in game quality 

We keep working on the game for the additional content scheduled. 
All players can expect future free updates ! 

Content of future updates soon : 
Level 4 release 
Level 5 release 
Releases of levels 6 - 7 part 1 and 7 part 2 

We would like to thank all the community members for your support and patience 
because we know that many of you have been with us since the beginning of the project ! 

We are proud to present it to you and really hope you enjoy the game. 

Thanks to all of you,  
The Lomay team
